boxOfficeInfo.openHoursDetail: The box office is open 60 minutes before the listed door time on show days at Saint Andrew's Hall, and 30 minutes before the listed door time on show days at The Shelter.
boxOfficeInfo.acceptedPaymentDetail: Cashless venue: all major credit cards accepted. Cash to card conversion is available without fees.
boxOfficeInfo.willCallDetail: Tickets can be picked up at the respective main entrance when our box offices open, which is 1 hour prior to doors for all Saint Andrew's Hall shows and 30 mins prior to doors for all shows in The Shelter. Please bring purchaser identification, charge card, and order confirmation numbers.

venues.parkingDetail: Saint Andrew's Hall does not own or operate parking but there are several garages and surface lots within one to two blocks of the venue. Saint Andrew's Hall has partnered with ParkWhiz to offer other easy and reliable options. Visit: https://www.parkwhiz.com/saint-andrew-s-hall-parking/?utm_medium=LiveNation&utm_source=1269&utm_campaign=Web_LN_ParkingPage_VenueLink to book parking ahead of time.
venues.accessibleSeatingDetail: Once you have purchased your General Admission ticket, call our box office at (313) 230-2436 and let us know the date of the show you are attending and any additional accommodations you of your party may need. When you arrive the day of the show, you can notify us of your arrival by calling our ADA coordinator at 313-230-2434 or head directly to the front of the line and our Guest Services team will assist you into the venue. At this time our team will escort you to the ADA section located on the right side of the main floor. If you need assistance at any time, there is a Guest Services team member assigned to the ADA section that can help you with anything you might need. Due to the historic nature of the building, the Balcony is accessible by stairs only.

generalInfo.generalRule: Camera Policy: Professional cameras and/or cameras will detachable lenses are NOT allowed without a valid media pass. Personal point-and-shoot cameras or cellphones are OK. Re-entry Policy: After your ticket has been scanned, there is no re-entry if you leave the venue. ID policy: A valid ID is required to attend any age restricted events and to consume alcohol. Accepted forms of identification include state-issued ID or Driver's License, valid non-expired US Government or Military ID, or an official passport. Bag Policy: Clear plastic, vinyl or PVC bags (maximum size: 12"x6"x12") or small clutch bags approximately the size of a hand (maximum size: 4.5"x6.5") are permitted. Prohibited Items: - Professional photo/video equipment (unless approved photo pass from artist) - Selfie sticks - Video cameras or go-pros - Toy weapons - Masks - Illegal substances/drugs/drug paraphernalia - Pets, unless it is a registered service animal - Laser pointers/glow sticks/LED gloves or microlights - Pacifiers - Eye drops - Metal studded/spiked clothing, jewelry and accessories - Hula Hoops - Markers/pens/spray paint - Balloons/inflatable balls - Candy bracelets/necklaces - Large purses/bags/backpacks/drawstring bags - Weapons of any kind (mini pepper spray/knives/fireworks) - Firearms (including off duty law enforcement and CPL holders)
generalInfo.childRule: All guests ages 3 and older need a ticket for entry. Please note, age requirements differ depending on the event. All age requirements are listed on our online event calendar. If no age restriction is listed, the event is all ages.

boxOfficeInfo.openHoursDetail: The Fox Theatre Box Office is open on event days only, from 12:00 pm until until 30 minutes after show start time. boxOfficeInfo.acceptedPaymentDetail: MasterCard, Visa, Discover, and American Express are accepted.
boxOfficeInfo.willCallDetail: Will Call tickets are available beginning 2 hours prior to showtime. Customers will needs their Confirmation Number, the credit card the order was placed under and Photo Identification.

venues.parkingDetail: Fee based lot parking is located in the Fox Parking Tower, next to the Theatre. The Fox Parking Structure is located between Woodward Avenue and Park Street, just south of I-75 (Fisher Freeway.) Entrances are on the Fisher Freeway service drive and Montcalm Street; the 1,100-car parking tower is well lit, secure and includes 32 handicapped parking spaces (handicapped parking spaces are adjacent to the glass elevators on all eight levels.)
venues.accessibleSeatingDetail: To request accessible seating, please call (313) 471-7929.

generalInfo.generalRule: All bags, purses, and clutches are prohibited. Wallets sized 4" x 6" x 1.5" or smaller) and Diaper Bags/Medical Bags (16" x 16" x 8") allowed. Generally, cameras, audio, and video recorders are not permitted in the Fox Theatre; this policy, however, is altered to accommodate the preference of the artist. To inquire if cameras or recording equipment are permitted for a particular event, please contact us at (313) 471-7929
generalInfo.childRule: Child age policy varies per event; please contact the venue at (313) 471-7929 to inquire.

generalInfo.generalRule: To ensure that all guests have a safe and enjoyable visit to Ford Field, guests are not permitted to bring the following items into the stadium: (this list may change slightly depending on event. Please call 313-262-2000 with any questions) • Aerosol cans (hair spray, mace, pepper spray, etc.) • Animals (except assistive animals for people with disabilities) • Bags: (grocery, duffle, backpacks, luggage, large bags, large purses, large camera cases, etc.) 8 1/2” x 14” x 10” is maximum size for entry • Balloons (air or helium) • Balls (beach balls, footballs, baseballs, etc.) • Banners • Beverages or liquids (cans, bottles or boxes) • Camcorders and tripods • Cameras (professional) or cameras with lenses over five inches long and/or 50mm and above • Cans & bottles • Confetti or glitter • Coolers of any kind, including small soft pack coolers • Decals or stickers • Fireworks • Food • Illegal substances • Laser pointers • Markers (permanent) and/or paint • Noisemaking devices (bells, horns, kazoos, whistles, etc.) • Objects that can be used as missiles or projectiles (sticks, bats, clubs, frisbees, etc.) • Strollers and infant/car seats or carriers • Umbrellas • Weapons No weapons are allowed in the Stadium. Possession of a firearm or any other weapon is strictly forbidden. Possession of such a weapon will result in immediate confiscation, ejection and possible arrest. The following items will be permitted after inspection: • Binoculars and binocular cases • Cameras and small camera cases (must comply with the camera/lens limits) • Diaper bags (only if accompanied by a child) • Small bags, purses and fanny packs (must comply with the bag limits) • Small radios (must be used with an earpiece) • Signs (must comply with standards of taste and decency; no profane or offensive messages; must not block another guest's view) To ensure the highest level of safety and security, all guests are subject to a courteous screening upon entering Ford Field. Please note that all personal belongings will be subject to inspection upon entry into the stadium. Prohibited items that are discovered during security inspections at the stadium entrances must either be returned to the owner's vehicle or discarded. Items will not be held for later pickup. Unlawful items that are discovered during inspections are subject to being confiscated, and the person in possession of those items is subject to ejection and/or arrest. Ejection from the game will be without refund and may result in the loss of season ticket privileges. For your convenience and added security, Ford Field uses a scanning turnstile method of ticket validation. Ford Field provides guests with optimum security by incorporating the NFL's first-rate security program, 'Best Practices' into our overall security plan. Security measures include: close-circuit TV cameras, screening, pat-down and bag inspection processes, and a host of other methods and systems.
generalInfo.childRule: Children ticket rules change depending on event. For Detroit Lions home games, children two (2) years of age and under will be permitted to enter Ford Field without a ticket. venues.accessibleSeatingDetail: Once you have purchased your General Admission ticket, call our box office at (313) 230-2436 and let us know the date of the show you are attending and any additional accommodations you of your party may need. When you arrive the day of the show, you can notify us of your arrival by calling our ADA coordinator at 313-230-2434 or head directly to the front of the line and our Guest Services team will assist you into the venue. At this time our team will escort you to the ADA section located on the right side of the main floor. If you need assistance at any time, there is a Guest Services team member assigned to the ADA section that can help you with anything you might need. Due to the historic nature of the building, the Balcony is accessible by stairs only.
